svg.title: One request through frontend, backend and database
svg.desc: Animated architecture diagram. Frontend: the user clicks Load; skeleton rows wait. Backend: the request passes router, JWT auth, validation and the service layer. Database: a query joins students to majors and selects IT students. The JSON response flows back and the list renders real rows.
svg.text: -- one click, three worlds, one round trip
Interface → API → Logic → Query → Response → Interface
event → request → logic → query → response → render
The user picks a filter and clicks “Load”.
Route matched → token verified → input validated → rules applied
SELECT … FROM students JOIN majors … WHERE m.code = 'IT'
The list re-renders: skeleton rows become real data.
